verdict.rationale: Rippling's own marketing describes real-time automatic provisioning and revocation that updates access, permissions, and groups, and lists support for custom SCIM apps. That establishes the core capability, but the depth of SCIM push behavior is not documented. missing for 10: technical documentation of outbound SCIM pushes of users, groups, and entitlements to downstream apps, explicit entitlement or role mapping per app, evidence of trigger-on-assignment latency, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, accounts create themselves — SCIM provisioning pushes users, groups, and entitlements into downstream apps the moment access is assigned

citations.quote: Federated identity lets you handle any protocol with ease—from LDAP, Active Directory (AD), OIDC, and RADIUS, to custom SCIM and SAML apps.
Rippling monitors your org in real time and automatically provisions or revokes access based on role changes, risk signals, and company policy.
From provisioning accounts to managing group access, dynamic rules automatically ensure the right people get the right level of access—even as their roles change.
When roles changes or someone leaves, Rippling automatically updates access, permissions, and groups.
Rippling instantly provisions access, secures endpoints, and automates compliance without you having to switch systems.
